title: Aside
subtitle: Your Notion tasks on Even G2
note: recorded from the Even Hub simulator

scenes.caption: Today's tasks from your Notion database, overdue first.
Tap a task to act on it.
Brief me: the task's Notion page, cut down to what fits the display.
Done. One tap, and the page is updated in Notion the way that database expects.
Hold the touchpad and say a task. (No microphone in an automated run: this transcript is scripted.)
"Remind me to call the bank next Friday about the mortgage" comes back as a draft with a date.
Nothing is written until you tap. Tap: saved to Notion.
Hold again and ask instead: "what is due this week?"
Questions only read. Tap to go back.
Not today? Move it to tomorrow.
The system menu has capture and refresh, from any screen.
